reason: The cited evidence (E1–E4) does not address the key premises: E1 discusses CoCrFeMnNi properties and corrosion, E2 is a general HEA review mentioning WC, E3 concerns BCC refractory HEAs and VEC, and E4 covers coatings on Q235B steel. None provide specific prior evidence on the mechanical behavior, dislocation mechanisms, or dynamic response of Co-free FeNiCrMn, leaving all premises unsupported.
premises: Co-free FeNiCrMn retains comparable or better mechanical performance than equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi
Dynamic properties of related HEAs are sensitive to loading regime and material condition
Dislocation mobility is temperature- and strain-rate dependent, controlling strain hardening vs. dynamic recovery
At low temperatures/high strain rates, limited dislocation mobility causes accumulation and pinning, enhancing strength
At elevated temperatures, enhanced dislocation mobility facilitates dynamic recovery, softening the alloy
